Reference image for the [[Jokes#The Good, the Bad and the Ugly|The Good, the Bad and the Ugly]] running gag on [[Jokes]], beside [[Bron Burs]], the card whose lore casts him as "the Ugly": Tuco (Eli Wallach), the Ugly, in the desert with a hangman's rope on his shoulder, in ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'' (1966).

Source: a frame at 1:40 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WCnRSl24FPA The Good, The Bad and The Ugly | Official Sizzle | 4K], Arrow Video, YouTube (3 July 2025), from the 3840 by 2160 stream. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260807221951/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WCnRSl24FPA Internet Archive], 7 August 2026. Identification: the same video's cast title card, at about 1:36, reads "and Eli Wallach in the role of Tuco". Cropped to Wallach and reduced to 700 by 717 pixels. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: ac66c123aa6164f4cc1c0211d2d70c41368f62e4ddd7a5f939e33ca48b224eff.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single cropped, reduced-size frame from a distributor's promotional video for ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'', © Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, used only to show the character the card refers to, beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the character exists.
